name: @w6w-apps/telnyx
description: Send SMS/MMS, place and control voice calls, and look up phone numbers via Telnyx.

w6w.longDescription:
Telnyx is a programmable voice, messaging and numbers platform, and this app covers the core of each: send an SMS or MMS and look one up by ID, place an outbound Call Control call and hang it up, look up a phone number's carrier or caller-name data, and list the numbers on the account.

Two things about the surface are worth knowing before using it. Sending a message only queues it — the response's per-recipient status is `queued`/`sending`, not `delivered` — so a workflow that needs the final outcome should read `get-message` again or listen on a webhook. Placing a call needs a Call Control Application created once in the Telnyx portal (its ID is the `connectionId` this app asks for); the call itself is asynchronous, returning a `call_control_id` before the destination has answered, with that answer arriving later as a webhook this app does not wait for.

Telnyx's much larger surface — Call Control's ~40 in-call actions (gather, playback, recording, SIP transfer, AI assistants), WhatsApp/RCS messaging, number ordering/porting, and the Fax, Video and Wireless products — is deliberately out of scope; see the README for the full list of what this app does not cover.
